content: @tanstack/react-virtual v3 sticky day separators: flat item array with {type:'message'|'separator'} entries. rangeExtractor override always includes active sticky separator index. Active separator: position:sticky; top:0; z-index:2; NO transform. Non-active separators: position:absolute; transform:translateY(). Use measureElement ref for dynamic heights. estimateSize for initial estimates. Find active separator = highest separator index <= virtualizer.range.startIndex.
